hero.sub: We help regulated organisations in government, health, and finance explore, adopt, and deploy AI in ways that are human-centred, responsible, and trusted — whether you are just starting out or already in production.
gap.left.heading: Your organisation is moving towards AI.
gap.left.body: You have ambition, budget, and pressure to act. You may have a pilot running, a vendor shortlisted, or a leadership mandate to deliver.
gap.right.heading: But is your organisation actually ready?
gap.right.body: Technology is the easy part. What derails AI adoption is the human layer: trust, communication, governance, accessibility, and organisational readiness. These are design problems — and they need to be solved early, not retrofitted at the end.
gap.callout: We work with organisations at every stage — from early exploration and innovation through to production deployment and compliance. The earlier you address the human layer, the less it costs to get right.
services.heading: Three ways we work with you
services.s1.title: Trust Audit
services.s1.body: We assess your AI system or AI adoption plans against the four Trust Layer principles — explainability, recoverability, accessibility, and human control — and show you exactly where the gaps are, whether you are in discovery or in production.
services.s2.title: Framework Implementation
services.s2.body: We design and build the Trust Layer into your AI systems, innovation projects, and organisational processes — working alongside your technical, product, UX, compliance, and leadership teams from early exploration through to deployment.
services.s3.title: EU AI Act Readiness
services.s3.body: We map your high-risk AI obligations — current and anticipated — and build the human-centred compliance layer your organisation needs. Enforcement is underway. We help you move from documentation to implementation.
sectors.heading: We work with regulated industries deploying high-risk AI
sectors.gov.title: Government
sectors.gov.body: Federal agencies, ministries, and public institutions deploying AI in citizen-facing services.
sectors.health.title: Healthcare
sectors.health.body: Hospitals, insurers, and health technology companies using AI for diagnosis, triage, or patient decisions.
sectors.finance.title: Finance
sectors.finance.body: Banks, insurers, and financial institutions using AI for credit, fraud, or eligibility decisions.
evidence.heading: Built on research. Validated in practice.
evidence.p1: The Trust by Design framework was developed through independent research across 14+ AI implementation teams in the German public sector, and validated through advisory work with regulated organisations across government, health, and finance.
evidence.p2: We don't consult from the outside. We've built government AI systems from the inside — including Germany's first BITV-certified government application, with over a million users.
evidence.strip: i-Kfz · Germany's first BITV-certified government app · 1M+ downloads · Presented to 6+ German government communities · MA Design for Responsible AI · EU AI Act specialist

tools.audit.body: Run your own Trust Layer assessment. Identify explainability, recovery, accessibility, and control gaps in your AI system.
tools.bridge.body: See how the Trust Layer works in practice across government, health, and finance.
